face_index_rule: entry = 0x40765c(person): pid = word person+0 & 0xfff; v = u16 face_table[pid] (VA 0x50f000, = the person face field word +4, copied by 0x423e30); entry = v + 7 if v != 0 else 0. The same entry indexes Face.e5 and Fb.e5.

sources.large: E5/Face.e5 (archive object 0x4ac538, opened by 0x42be51): 120x120 face in the dialog window (0x42d3f5, 0x42de7d, 0x46d742, 0x431c19 ... mode 10 = key transparent) and in the status / person windows (0x45c697, 0x469ecb, 0x44cbaa: mode 0x60 = key pixels turned black, drawn opaque). Entries 596..627 include taller pictures (large_odd_sizes).
sources.fb: E5/Fb.e5 (object 0x4ac430): 192x272 portraits of the three-portrait dialog window 0x42d8bf -> 0x42d0a9 (600x356 window; portrait i at x = 6 + 198*i; persons not speaking are dimmed by 0x40690c). Entries identical to Face.e5 (120x120) are not exported: fb_faces lists the entries that have their own picture.

transparency: colour key (247,0,255) within <10 per channel -> alpha 0
